text:
asha: Heads-up — running a small-cohort live workshop next Wed (60 seats max). Need final reg page copy, Zoom setup for breakout facilitation, recording/transcript plan, and post-event clip + lead routing. Can we lock everything by EOD Friday?

miguel: Quick product note — market the session as 'hands-on lab' and call out 'limited seats'. Also suggest localized times on the reg page (one session but show 3 timezones). Keeps ops simpler.

priya: I can own the landing copy. CTA: 'Reserve your seat' => map to HubSpot form. Add explicit recording + reuse consent checkbox. Hidden fields: utm_campaign=cohort_lab, source=marketing, session_id=wed-cohort-1.

ben: Zoom tech: enable Cloud Record + Auto-Transcribe. Breakouts won't record separately on cloud by default. Options: (A) have each facilitator record locally (messy), (B) OBS on a co-host machine to capture the main room + slides, then split in post, (C) live clip snapshots using Zoom's live-stream API. Leaning to OBS route for clean assets.

sam_eventops: I can provision an OBS VM and be co-host/recorder. Proposed Zoom roles: host (asha), co-host (sam), 2 facilitators. We'll also enable 'Allow participants to unmute' and 'Breakout rooms pre-assign'. Need to confirm slide deck share resolution (720p okay).

asha: Output plan: full gated replay for registrants + ~6 short clips (1–2 min) for socials + transcript. Who will own clip editing and gating? Also we need tags in HubSpot for: webinar=cohort_lab, attended=yes/no, interest=workshop.

priya: I can own clip selection & edit requests. Plan: Otter -> AssemblyAI for more accurate transcript, then pick timestamps for clips. For gating, replay goes to a HubSpot landing page that requires the same email as registered.

miguel: Post-event automation idea: 1) Zoom cloud -> S3 (Zapier or Zoom webhook) 2) Trigger AssemblyAI for transcript 3) Generate clip timestamps CSV (manual/PR) 4) ffmpeg batch to cut clips -> Wistia or S3 5) HubSpot workflow: tag leads, send attended/no-show sequence.

ben: Quick snippet for a Zapier/Zoom cloud export webhook (example):

curl -X POST \"https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/12345/zoom-recording\" \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"download_url":"<zoom_recording_download>","meeting_id":"<id>"}'

ben: For ffmpeg batch cutting we can use a CSV with start/end times and run: 

while IFS=, read start end label; do ffmpeg -i full.mp4 -ss $start -to $end -c copy \"clips/${label}.mp4\"; done < clips.csv

sam_eventops: Ops checklist (short):
- Confirm HubSpot form + hidden fields (priya)
- Lock reg page copy + CTAs (priya)
- Provision OBS recorder & test 24h before (sam)
- Confirm facilitators record local fallback (ben)
- Post-event pipeline runbook (miguel)
- Social clip specs: 1080x1080, <60s, subtitles burned in (priya)

miguel: Reporting: add UTM params in registration links, track visits -> conversions -> attended. Add analytics event for 'clip_download' when we upload to Wistia.

asha: Owners: Priya (copy + clips), Ben (zoom config + transcoding helpers), Sam (obs + test), Miguel (post-event automation + runbook). I'll coordinate comms. Please confirm by EOD Fri or I'll escalate. :thumbsup:

priya: Confirmed — I'll drop the draft reg copy in #marketing-assets by Thursday noon.

ben: Confirmed. I'll test OBS capture this week and share settings.

sam_eventops: Confirmed. I'll schedule a dry-run with OBS + Zoom 24h pre-event.

zoombot: Zoom meeting created: meeting_id=9876543210. Cloud recording enabled. Recording files will be available 10–15 min after session end.

asha: Great — locking plan. We'll follow the checklist and meet if any blocker shows up. Thanks all.
